sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Texintel is a digital textile printing news, technology, and insight platform that serves 220,000+ textile industry professionals.

Industry: Digital Textile Printing · Size: 5000+

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Texintel scores 35 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 100% confidence. The score is carried by company size (15/15) and event engagement (15/15). Nothing was found for industry fit and application fit, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Mactac (25% similar on printing, print, digital, chemical); Drytac (20% similar on print, printing, media, display); ORAFOL Europe (12% similar on printing, digital, graphic, performance). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Industry fit: 3 more core category terms in its positioning would reach the ceiling.
• Application fit: 4 more application area(s) would reach the ceiling.
